description: SCOUT's building rasterizer, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Rasterize Buildings node turns a buildings layer into the zoom-16 height tiles SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model reads, side by side in one raster in metres that an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Raster Conversion

templates.description: SCOUT's OSM vector to raster: draws each building's height into 256 by 256 map tiles at a zoom level, 8-bit gray where 255 is the maximum height, in EPSG:3395. Input: a buildings GeoDataFrame with a column of heights in metres. Output: one RASTER of the tiles side by side, heights in metres, band band_1, for an Autark map and for Accumulated Shadow (model.scout.deep-umbra), which runs SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model on it. A tile SCOUT writes no file for, because no building is near it, is no data.
templates.label: Rasterize Buildings
